name: plan.readiness
description: Gate a spec/plan BEFORE any code is written. Stops the most expensive failure: building the wrong thing well.

has_acceptance_criteria.instructions: The plan states concrete, checkable acceptance criteria -- not aspirations like 'works well' or 'is fast'

names_the_user_decision.instructions: The plan names the actual decision or job the user is trying to complete, not just a feature to add

unverifiable_claims.instructions: The plan asserts outcomes, numbers, or benefits with no stated source or measurement method

scope_is_bounded.instructions: The scope is bounded: a reader could tell what is explicitly NOT included

deterministic_first.instructions: The plan reaches for an LLM or agent where ordinary deterministic code would do the job

readiness.instructions: How ready is this plan to hand to a coding agent unattended
criteria: Vague idea, no contract, would produce guesswork
Direction is clear but acceptance is undefined
Contract and acceptance defined, some ambiguity at the edges
Fully specified: inputs, outputs, acceptance tests, and out-of-scope all stated

rules.reason: no checkable acceptance criteria -- the agent has nothing to be graded against
ProofPacket violation: asserts outcomes with no source
reaching for agentic where deterministic would do
plan not ready for unattended build
feature described without the user decision it serves
